digest.component_or_area: close precheck and completion attestation reuse
propositions: close unconditionally dispatches the completion provider via verify_with_auto_resume even when the ticket already carries a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS bound to the exact resolved close SHA
the close precheck seam does not consult existing signed completion op-cert attestations before invoking the provider, despite having access to authenticated SHA pins and material fingerprints

a fail-safe reuse check must verify that stored completion attestations are cryptographically valid, have PASS status, and match the resolved close target SHA and current material fingerprint before skipping provider dispatch
eligible same-ref attested PASS records must yield zero provider calls during close while remaining ineligible, malformed, stale, or reopened attestations must fall through to fresh verification
the reuse decision must not alter the normal close, durable verdict, or post-close signing path when a valid attestation is reused
